name: session-namer
description: Automatically titles every Claude Code session "<project> - <topic>" from the first prompt. Works in the CLI, VS Code and Remote Control, on Windows, macOS and Linux.

model.title: Model for topic generation
model.description: Model alias or id used to summarise the first prompt into a short topic. Fast models are ideal.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: Text placed between the project name and the topic.

max_words.title: Maximum topic words
max_words.description: Upper bound for the number of words in the generated topic (3 to 12).

timeout_ms.title: Generation timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the topic before giving up and keeping the project-only title.

project_source.title: Project name source
project_source.description: "git" uses the repository folder name (shared by all worktrees); "cwd" uses the current folder name.

name_headless.title: Also name headless (claude -p) sessions
name_headless.description: When false, sessions started with -p are left untouched to avoid an extra model call.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. Turn off to keep the plugin installed but inactive.
